recipe.variant: 3B Int8 (3.46 GB): the official template file for both image and video; docs: 'lower VRAM'; scale 4, 1 step, cfg 1, denoise 1, color correction none
recipe.from_template: utility_seedvr2_3b_int8_upscale_image (subgraph 'Upscale Image (SeedVR2 3B Int8)' flattened; the ImageCompare preview dropped). Template resize node is ResizeImageMaskNode ('scale by multiplier', lanczos). Written here as ImageScaleBy (lanczos, scale_by): the same lanczos resample of the IMAGE (RGBA passes through), because the offline validator cannot type ResizeImageMaskNode's COMFY_MATCHTYPE_V3 socket. Swap back on the box if the v3 node is preferred.

scale.note: upscale factor; the DiT restores at the resolution it is handed (template default 4 for stills, 2 for video). VRAM and time scale with output megapixels x frames

seed.note: one-step models still consume noise: the seed changes micro-detail

denoise.note: 1.0 = full restore (template); lower values are exposed by the template but undocumented

sampler_name.note: euler (template); no official guidance beyond the default

color_correction_method.note: none (template) | lab (node default, 'most faithful', most memory) | wavelet | adain

unet_name.note: swap precision/size here: see profile.files (same graph for every seedvr2_* file)

sampler.note: the sampling method (ComfyUI's sampler list: euler, dpmpp_2m, res_multistep, …)

image.note: the still to restore/upscale (any size: H/W are padded to multiples of 16 by SeedVR2Preprocess and cropped back by SeedVR2PostProcessing). Alpha is carried by JoinImageWithAlpha and re-applied after.

recipe.defaults_note: scale 4 (template default for stills); KSampler steps 1 / cfg 1 / euler / simple / denoise 1 (one-step model, steps and cfg are not ports); VAE tiling 512/128 with temporal_size 4096 (a still is one frame); color_correction_method none (node default is lab). No text prompt: SeedVR2Conditioning supplies the fixed positive/negative embeddings stored in the converted checkpoint. docs.comfy.org tip for very large stills: downscale to ~0.35 megapixels (ImageScaleToTotalPixels) before upscaling.

vram_evidence.gpu: RTX 5090 (official 17-cell resolution sweep + T bisection, 3B fp16)
vram_evidence.usage: max_latent_frames = (free_GiB - 8.5 - 4*0.55) / (0.55 * output_megapixels); pixel frames = 4*latent_frames - 3. Example (3B fp16, RTX 5090): 1920x1080 output = 2.07 Mpx -> 1.14 GiB per latent frame; 24 GiB free -> ~11 latent frames ~ 41 pixel frames per chunk
